title: Creator portrait / Gesture
slide_intent: Preserve an individual’s distinctive gestures and appearance so a shared photography style does not flatten personality.
strategic_value: A consistent isolated portrait treatment can accommodate visibly different Twitch creators.
demonstration: A bearded man holds his jacket near his chest against a pale green field; tattooed hands and clothing remain visible.
practical_value: Compare this crop with other creator portraits to judge which personal details should remain in frame.

content_islands.name: Figure and gesture
content_islands.spec: Keep the face, beard, jacket and both tattooed hands inside the torso-up crop.

content_islands.name: Pale green ground
content_islands.spec: Separate the figure with a clean pale green field.

reference_purposes.Intent: COLLINS describes Twitch as supporting creators and describes the photography as a way to elevate them and invite participation.
reference_purposes.Expression: The photograph emphasizes individual appearance and gesture against a simple colored field.
